candidate.blueprint_locator: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control — hand hygiene, quality improvement and infection-control practices
candidate.blueprint_topic: Safety and Infection Prevention and Control — hand-hygiene monitoring
candidate.educational_objective: Interpret electronic hand-hygiene monitoring as a quality-improvement tool with useful reach but important measurement limitations.

options.A: Use the system to broaden monitoring and identify adherence patterns, but interpret its data with knowledge of what behaviors the system can and cannot detect and validate findings with other methods when needed
options.B: Treat electronic compliance percentages as a perfect measure of every CDC hand-hygiene indication and of the quality of hand-cleaning technique
options.C: Stop all other auditing or feedback because electronic monitoring eliminates measurement limitations and observer bias completely
options.D: Assume a detected dispenser activation proves that hand hygiene occurred at every clinically indicated moment and was performed correctly

candidate.rationale: Electronic monitoring can expand the volume and continuity of adherence data and may reduce some limitations of episodic direct observation. However, monitoring systems differ in what they detect and may not capture every clinical indication, technique quality, or context. Infection-prevention programs should use standardized monitoring, understand method limitations, validate data, and provide feedback rather than treating any single metric as perfect ground truth.
candidate.source_claim_supported: Electronic monitoring can support hand-hygiene quality improvement, but monitoring methods require validation and should not be treated as flawless measurement of all hand-hygiene behavior.
candidate.source_document_title: Infection Control Assessment and Response (ICAR) Tool; Isolation Precautions — Fundamental Elements

candidate.stem: A hospital adds an electronic hand-hygiene monitoring system to its quality-improvement program. Which interpretation of the electronic data is most appropriate?
